profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded software company founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, Australia, that develops collaboration and productivity tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its platform includes products such as Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Loom, and the company describes its offering as one connected platform for planning, tracking, and delivering work. Atlassian trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and reported revenue of approximately $5.215 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025.

The company's AI products tracked on this site include Confluence AI, a team wiki tool with smart links, automation, and Atlassian Cloud governance features, and Trello AI, which applies AI to project management and workflow automation within the same governance framework. Atlassian also references Rovo AI agents as part of its broader platform. The company's site notes that its products are designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements.

No litigation or MCP server records are held for Atlassian in the site's current data.
